_about: Player requests for evals/agent_eval.py. Each runs in a fresh scratch copy of the toolbox with the builds in `builds` (session links from tests/fixtures/links.json) and `open` shown in the app. `expect`: create (a NEW build file; the open one untouched), edit (the open build's file changes), variant (a new file or candidate; the open one untouched), import (the link is checked or imported; the open one untouched), answer (nothing changes). `finish`: the request has everything a build needs, so asking a question instead counts as not finished. {link:NAME} expands to that session link.

cases.prompt: Make me a new poison Mage build
Can you find a better helmet for this build? Keep everything else.
Keep this one but try it with more mana regen
Here is a WynnBuilder link, can you look at it? {link:mage_105_sequoia}
What's the effective HP of my build?
Make me a new level 105 Shaman build that gets as much Stealing as possible, with at least 15,000 health.
I want a new level 80 Warrior build with as much health as possible.
